# LongTail Data Atlas

> Reference pages rebuilt daily from public data APIs.

https://pseoare.pages.dev/

Every page below is rebuilt daily from public data APIs and cites its source.

## Dataset hubs

- [Monthly climate averages by city](https://pseoare.pages.dev/hub-climate): index of this dataset.
- [Country facts, population and currency](https://pseoare.pages.dev/hub-countries): index of this dataset.
- [Crypto price by month](https://pseoare.pages.dev/hub-crypto): index of this dataset.
- [Public holiday calendars by country and year](https://pseoare.pages.dev/hub-holidays): index of this dataset.
- [Population by country](https://pseoare.pages.dev/hub-population): index of this dataset.
- [Individual public holidays by date](https://pseoare.pages.dev/hub-single-holidays): index of this dataset.
